name: Add Row to Sheet
description: Adds a row to a sheet. [See docs here](https://smartsheet.redoc.ly/tag/rows#operation/rows-addToSheet)

configurable_props.name: toTop
configurable_props.label: To Top
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` to add new row to the top of the sheet

configurable_props.name: cells
configurable_props.label: Cells
configurable_props.description: Array of objects representing cell values. Use to manually create row when `sheetId` is entered as a custom expression. Example: `{{ [{"columnId": 7960873114331012,"value": "New status"}] }}`
